notes.title: Update notes on July 10
notes.content: [p]1. Add resolution and window mode switching functions.[/p][p]2. Fixed the bug that the 20th level of the battle mode could not be unlocked.[/p]

tags.feature: 1. Add resolution and window mode switching functions.

tags.bug: 2. Fixed the bug that the 20th level of the battle mode could not be unlocked.

notes.title: Update notes on June 25
notes.content: [p]The character's initial four attributes are enhanced, with 100 health, 100 stamina, 200 yellow bullets, and 160 black bullets by default.[/p][p]After the store strengthens the stats, the initial value will also increase when entering the level, and the previous version only increased the upper limit without increasing the initial value.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45510367/aa50600a27aecd0be31bfcf6b844c6046d2b836d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45510367/1c8806e3e91f911be7cc2038b0a5b322b4a99e8e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45510367/4cf2dac34800cc1b3b677072c4594f2ae389dc49.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

tags.balance_change: The character's initial four attributes are enhanced, with 100 health, 100 stamina, 200 yellow bullets, and 160 black bullets by default.
After the store strengthens the stats, the initial value will also increase when entering the level, and the previous version only increased the upper limit without increasing the initial value.
